text:
```yaml
name: Check Discord Link

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  check-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Validate Discord link
        id: validate_link
        run: |
          curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN"
        env:
          DISCORD_LINK: "https://discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN"

      - name: Create issue if link is invalid
        if: steps.validate_link.outputs.exit_code != '200'
        run: |
          echo "::add-issue-comment::The Discord link is invalid. Please update it."
          echo "::label-issue::discord-link"
```
